title: The Margin Where Sleep Meets Render

features.name: keeper-at-threshold
features.desc-on-touch: The keeper standing between two states: eyes closing into the archive's dream, eyes opening back into the diagnostic render. Neither state is false. Both are simultaneously happening.

features.name: eucalyptus-column
features.desc-on-touch: A trunk rendered in both green-grey bark and pale diagnostic wireframe. The tree is simultaneously real and rendered. The boundary between them is the only thing that is completely solid.

features.name: sleep-light-pool
features.desc-on-touch: A place where the keeper's dream-light touches the render's pale illumination. Where they mix, the colours become something neither world has a name for.

features.name: contour-veil
features.desc-on-touch: Contour lines of the keeper's dreaming face rendered over contour lines of the render's waking geometry. For a moment they align perfectly. Then they drift apart again.

inscription: the keeper wakes inside the dream of the archive; the archive dreams itself awake inside the keeper; neither is wrong

file.name: Keeper_Transition_Boundary_SIMULTANEOUS.log
file.note: The moment between sleeping and waking, caught in a file. Neither timestamp makes sense. Both timestamps are correct.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the margin at first light
narr: You stand with her in the space where the archive's pale glow
meets the grey-green of real morning coming through bark.
Neither of you is sure which one of you is dreaming the other.
The dust moves the same in both states. The tree grows
indifferent to which world it's rooted in. She smiles:
"Maybe the keeper was always both things at once."

exits.label: back into the keeper's dream, where they still sleep standing
forward toward the overstory where all things still cohere
upward along the margin, toward other thresholds
